no_backtest_was_run: This rule was written without running it on any history. Its parameters are round numbers chosen in advance, not fitted. No pre-window result exists, so none can be cited for it.
purpose: Forward-test one funding-carry rule (long BTC spot, short BTC perpetual, held only when recent funding is clearly positive) as a separate, info-only research track next to v4/v6. It is a different return source from trend following: it earns funding payments, not price moves.
decision_context: This adds a new rule; it changes nothing in v4/v6, their spec files, window or verdicts. Its verdict is reported separately and plays no part in the v4/v6 decision. Paper research only: it places no orders and needs no keys.

rule.name: carry-v1
rule.position_when_on: Long q BTC spot and short q BTC perp, same quantity q, so the position is close to price-neutral. Capital C is split in half: 0.5*C buys the spot leg and 0.5*C is perp margin. Perp notional at entry is 0.5*C, so the perp leg is 1x on its margin. No rebalancing while held.
rule.signal: At each funding settlement time T, m = mean of the last 21 funding rates with funding time <= T (about 7 days at the current 8h interval; the count is fixed at 21 records whatever the interval).
rule.entry: If off and m >= 0.0001 (0.01% per period), go on.
rule.exit: If on and m < 0.00005 (0.005% per period), go off.
rule.otherwise: Keep the current position (hysteresis band between 0.00005 and 0.0001).
rule.timing: A decision made at settlement T is executed at the open of the 1h bar that starts at T + 1h, at that bar's open price on each market (spot open for the spot leg, perp open for the perp leg). Funding records are only known after T, so this is causal.
rule.funding_earned: At each settlement T the position holds, cash += q * perp_open(bar starting at T) * rate(T). Positive rate: the short receives; negative rate: the short pays. Settlements where the position is off earn nothing. A position entered at T+1h first earns at the next settlement; a position exited at T+1h has earned at T.
rule.hard_limit: After the close of each 1h bar, if (perp_high of that bar - perp entry price) * q >= 0.5 * perp margin, the position is forced off at the next bar's open with exit costs. This is a conservative stand-in for liquidation. It is checked on the perp high, not the close. After a forced exit the normal entry rule applies again from the next settlement.

accounting.equity: cash (which already holds funding received and costs paid) + q * spot_close + perp margin + q * (perp_entry - perp_close), marked at every 1h close while on; equal to cash while off.
accounting.costs: On every entry and exit, each leg pays cost_per_side * that leg's notional at the execution price. A full round trip costs about 4 * 0.0012 * 0.5 = 0.24% of capital.
accounting.return_on_capital: All returns and drawdowns are on the full capital C (spot leg plus margin), not on one leg's notional.

window_utc.embargo: No entry before 2026-11-19T00:00:00Z (the first 24 hours). The rule starts off (cash).
window_utc.first_decision: The first settlement that can lead to an entry is 2026-11-19T00:00Z, executed at the 01:00Z open. The 21-record mean may use funding records before the start (past data only).
window_utc.end_handling: Any open position is closed at the open of the 2027-11-17T00:00Z bar with exit costs on both legs. The 2027-11-17T00:00Z settlement is not earned, because the position is closed at that bar's open.

data.source: Binance public files on data.binance.vision, each zip verified against its .CHECKSUM before use: spot klines 1h (data/spot/.../klines/BTCUSDT/1h), USD-M futures klines 1h (data/futures/um/.../klines/BTCUSDT/1h), and USD-M funding rates (data/futures/um/monthly/fundingRate/BTCUSDT). Monthly zips where published, daily zips for the current month.
data.funding_lag: Funding-rate files are published monthly only, so interim reads stop at the last complete month. The complete-window verdict needs the November 2027 funding file, published around early December 2027.
data.causal_only: Decisions use only funding records with funding time <= the decision time and bars that have closed.
data.gaps: Missing hours and missing funding settlements are counted and reported. A gap longer than 24 hours in either kline series, or a missing settlement while the position is on, is an error, not something to repair by hand.
data.where: Research machine only. Not on the VPS. No exchange API keys: public files only.

costs.breakdown: 0.10% fee + 0.02% adverse price per side, applied to each leg separately. The same cost is used for spot and perp; perp fees are usually lower, so this is conservative.
costs.not_modeled: Borrow costs (none needed: spot is bought with cash), transfer fees between spot and futures wallets, and funding-rate prediction (only settled rates are used).

benchmark.info_only: BTC buy-and-hold and the funding received by an always-on carry position (before and after one round trip of costs) are reported for information. They play no part in pass/fail.

failure_criteria.applies_to: carry-v1 only, judged separately from v4 and v6
fail_if_any: total net return after costs over the full window <= 0 (does not beat cash)
max drawdown of the equity curve >= 0.35
failure_criteria.boundary_note: Same thresholds and same strict reading as forward_v4_v6.json: a drawdown of exactly 35% is a failure.
failure_criteria.consequence_of_fail: The rule is dropped. No re-tuning of the thresholds, lookback or hard limit, no re-run, no new window for the same idea.
failure_criteria.consequence_of_pass: The rule survives one out-of-sample year. It is weak evidence and not a profitability claim: the trade count is low and the year is one funding regime. A pass is not approval for live trading; Phase 3/4 gates and trading-safety still apply, and real carry adds exchange and wallet risks this test does not model.

evaluation.runner: Not built yet. A later PR adds src/signal_desk/research/carry_v1.py with download, forward and backcheck commands in the style of klines_v4/klines_v6. It must pin this file's sha256 and refuse any other, and forward must refuse to overwrite an existing output file. The runner may not change any rule here; if building it shows the rule is ambiguous or wrong, that is a new spec version with a new forward window starting the day it is committed.
evaluation.backcheck: The runner may run on pre-window history for debugging only. That output is descriptive, is not evidence, and cannot change this spec.
evaluation.verdict_runs: Once, on the complete window: the first run on data that includes the 2027-11-17T00:00Z bar on both markets and every funding settlement before it. The verdict from that run stands; it is not re-run or replaced. The operator commits the JSON output with its git_commit and spec_sha256.
evaluation.interim_reads: Allowed for information only (verdict 'interim_no_verdict'). They never change the rule, costs, window or criteria.
report_must_include: window, first and exit bar, missing hours per series, missing funding settlements
spec version, spec sha256, runner version, git commit
total net return after costs, CAGR, Sharpe, max drawdown
round trips, forced exits from the hard limit, settlements held and settlements available
return split: funding received, spot leg, perp leg, costs
fraction of time on and state at the last decision
verdict against failure_criteria, plus the caveat that trade counts are too low to be strong evidence

safety.paper_only: execution_enabled=false stays enforced. This test places no orders, paper or real, and needs nothing on the VPS.

known_limits: The rule switches only a few times a year, so the window will hold only a handful of round trips.

One year is one funding regime. Funding is high in bull markets and near zero or negative in bear markets; at the time of writing BTC is well below its long averages, so the rule may stay off for long stretches.
Basis risk: spot and perp prices are not identical, so the position is close to, but not exactly, price-neutral.
Liquidation is only approximated by the 50% margin hard limit; real margin rules, mark price and the exchange insurance fund are not modeled.
Exchange and counterparty risk (insolvency, withdrawal freezes, auto-deleveraging) is not modeled and is the main risk of real carry trades.
